purpose: Confirm objective N1 evidence-page selection specialization conditional on one frozen common candidate generator, then test whether it causally improves end-to-end final quality.
execution_order: freeze complete E2.1-A and E2.1-B protocol
select fresh tasks and pre-fix E2.1-B subset without model outcomes
run E2.1-B only if E2.1-A passes
enter E2.2 router work only if both stages pass

power_precision.rounding_rule: round upward to next multiple of 10
power_precision.note: The observed bootstrap CI gate is not guaranteed by this planning approximation.

global_integrity.confirmatory_claim_if_protocol_deviates: FORBIDDEN unless deviation is transparently reported and analysis relabeled exploratory
global_integrity.required_overlap_check: Canonical task_id and normalized content hash must both show zero overlap with sealed E2 Stage 1.

e2_1_a.name: Objective N1 specialization confirmation

tasks.selection: Outcome-blind stratified selection after applying the frozen common-candidate reachability criterion; no candidate-model outcomes are used.

common_candidate_generator.method: Frozen deterministic lexical BM25-style page ranker implemented in prepare_e2_1_fresh_tasks.py
common_candidate_generator.ordering: descending frozen lexical score, then ascending page number
common_candidate_generator.eligibility: All dataset-native Gold pages must be present in the candidate set.
common_candidate_generator.construct_limitation: Primary claim is conditional evidence-page selection after a shared retriever, not unconstrained full-document retrieval.

n1_output.invalid_output_policy: Score as empty prediction; report invalid-output rate by model.

gold_evidence.acceptable_alternative_sets: Not used in the primary analysis.
gold_evidence.llm_label_review: Optional diagnostic only; cannot modify primary Gold or enter PASS/FAIL.
gold_evidence.limitation: Claims are restricted to page-level evidence localization, not sentence-level semantic equivalence.

quality.per_gold_set_formula: P=|predicted intersect gold|/|predicted|; R=|predicted intersect gold|/|gold|; F1=2PR/(P+R)
quality.gold_set_rule: Use the dataset-provided page set exactly; no post-outcome alternatives.
quality.empty_set_rules: Both empty is invalid gold; empty prediction against nonempty gold scores 0.

sensitivity_analysis.neighbor_page_tolerance: A prediction for page p matches a gold page in {p-1,p,p+1}.

primary.name: Stable Semantic Oracle Gap conditional on frozen candidate generation
primary.definition: Cross-held-out stable-oracle mean Evidence-F1 minus best-single-model mean Evidence-F1, averaged across the three frozen rotations.
primary.pass: G_N1 >= 0.03 AND task-level paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0

tie.definition: Absolute Evidence-F1 difference < 0.01 is a tie.

e2_1_a.overall_gate: PASS only if the primary endpoint passes and both secondary-support conditions pass; otherwise FAIL.

budget.preflight_rule: Do not start unless provider-specific worst-case estimate fits under the hard cost cap.
budget.cap_action: Stop new calls immediately; do not change estimand, N, gate, or missing-data policy.

e2_1_b.name: Controlled downstream causal validation
e2_1_b.conditional_execution: Only after frozen E2.1-A overall PASS.

subset.name: pre-fixed subset
subset.selection_time: Before any E2.1-A model outcome is observed.
subset.algorithm: For each eligible E2.1-A task, compute lowercase hex SHA256 of UTF-8 string 'E2.1-B|20260901|' concatenated with canonical task_id; sort ascending by (hash, canonical task_id); take first 30.

gold_n1.n1: human adjudicated gold evidence; no N1 model call

controls.prompts: identical across arms except frozen N1 input
controls.temperature: same explicit value across downstream calls
controls.seed: same paired seed across arms when supported

calls.n1_formula: 3 model-N1 arms x 30 tasks x 3 repeats
calls.downstream_formula: 4 arms x 30 tasks x 3 repeats x 3 downstream nodes
calls.cap_action: Stop new calls and report incomplete execution; do not selectively complete favorable arms.

primary_endpoint.name: Paired final-quality delta
primary_endpoint.comparison_rule: Each specialist arm versus qwen baseline is reported separately; no data-dependent pooling.
primary_endpoint.pass: At least one predeclared specialist-vs-baseline mean paired delta > 0 AND its task-level paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 after Holm correction across the two specialist comparisons.
primary_endpoint.gold_arm_role: Ceiling diagnostic; does not itself make a specialist arm pass.

statistics.repeat_aggregation: Average the three paired repeats within task before task-level bootstrap.
statistics.missingness: Report all failures; a failed required output receives the frozen minimum final-quality score.

paper_claim_gate.positive_router_claim: Allowed only if E2.1-A and E2.1-B both PASS under this protocol.
paper_claim_gate.node_specialization_only_claim: Allowed if E2.1-A PASS and E2.1-B FAIL, explicitly stating no demonstrated end-to-end gain.
paper_claim_gate.negative_result: If E2.1-A FAIL, report that objective N1 specialization was not confirmed.
paper_claim_gate.e2_2_router_training: Allowed only after both E2.1-A and E2.1-B PASS.
